description: Regular comedy nights, anywhere in the world, that people have listed on JokeStack (called Sceny on the Polish site): open mics and recurring shows, with or without a dated event. Use it for 'where can I perform stand-up in Gdańsk?' or 'is there an improv night in Poznań?'. Returns each scene's name, city, kind, whether it's still running, and link. For dated events, use jokestack_search_events.

confirmed_only.description: Only scenes someone confirmed as still running in the last 365 days.

language.description: Language for names and links: 'pl' for jokestack.pl, 'en' for the English site. Defaults to the site that was called.

offset.description: How many results to skip, for the next page.

place.description: A city or region anywhere, e.g. 'Gdańsk', 'Pomorskie' or 'Berlin'. Leave out to search everywhere.

text.description: Words to find in the name, venue or city, e.g. 'piwnica'.

name: jokestack_search_scenes
title: Search comedy scenes
